Hi I apologize for the late response. I was away from computer for a while. The initial details should be sent. I look forward to working with you!
Thank you for submitting the project requirements. Could you please share an inspirational website or a draft that you are already working on?
We need to know if there is any back-end functionality that you are looking for in a website.
Sure, so far I have a couple of pages of inspiration. I'll continue to send inspiration through.
Can you clarify what back-end functionality means specifically?
Apart from the booking functionality, is there any other feature that you want to add to your website, like a membership portal, etc.?
Yes, please share some inspirational websites.

I had this idea of having an instant quote calculator. This would be to give clients the ability to fill out a form or quiz that gives questions on what services they wish to receive and the form calculates an estimated price in real time. I was looking into it and it seems a bit complicated. would that be something you can do?
also for back end functionality maybe an interactive gallery giving viewers the ability to scroll through the gallery?
example with interactive gallery

Please note that a backend feature is the part of a website or app that works behind the scenes, and a website's communication with its database or with other platforms is involved.

For example, when you log in, save your information, place an order, or receive a notification, the backend is handling those tasks.

Regarding having an instant quote calculator, yes, I can do that, but I need further details to let you know how complicated it could be and whether it can be delivered in the current project scope or if some additional cost may occur. Please provide more details and the logic you want to implement behind the calculator so that I can guide you further.

As for the Gallery, yes, I can implement an eye-catching feature of the Gallery on your website.

Thank you!

Thank you so much for the clarification. In regard to the calculator, we have all of our services itemized. The more services they get, the more we can bundle. So the calculator would have to know when the services they choose qualify for a bundle or not. Otherwise it would be a simple addition for individual services. I imagine it would look like a survey. Potentially as follows:

Photos (yes/no)

Thank you so much for the clarification. In regard to the calculator, we have all of our services itemized. The more services they get, the more we can bundle. So the calculator would have to know when the services they choose qualify for a bundle or not. Otherwise it would be a simple addition for individual services. I imagine it would look like a survey. Potentially as follows:

How many sqft is the property (if under 1000 pricing tier 1, if 1001 - 2000 pricing tier 2, f 2001 - 3000 pricing tier 3, if 2001 - 3000 pricing tier 4, if 3001 + pricing tier 5 (*answers 1253 sqft* gets put into pricing tier 2)
Photos (yes/no) Yes = +200 No = +0 (*answers yes))*
*Videos? (yes/no)* Yes = +200 No = +0 (*answers yes))*
what is the address (calculates distance from home office) (if over 25 miles charge $50 dollar surcharge) (*Answers address and is 28 miles away))) +50*
*(qualifies for basic bundle) -$100*
*(presses submit)*
*Displays total : $350*
Would variables like this be possible?

Thank you for sharing the detailed workflow. This type of calculator is definitely possible; however, it is not a feature that WordPress provides out of the box. There are some plugins, but none of them meet your requirements. It requires custom development to handle the pricing logic, bundle rules, square footage tiers, distance calculations, and dynamic quote generation.

Based on the functionality you've described, I can develop it for an additional cost of USD 300, as it may take around 20-25 hours of custom development.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Thank you!

The only tabs we need would be photos, twilights, videos, floor plans, and 3d tour. Maybe a smaller section for other photography because sometimes we'll take one off clients. Hi, this is looking great! I have a couple of things. I think I found a glitch with the gallery. I've recorded a clip as follows. Could we also make the mobile version have no hover animations? I think it can be a bit jarring when the only way to hover is by touching the screen. Bonus points if we can reformat the mobile version of the pricing sheet so you don't have to scroll right to see all the info. I understand if that is too late to do, as we have already started implementing the site. Finally, can we have the buttons on the home screen direct to their corresponding pages (gallery, pricing, services)? Right now, it seems they just direct back to the top of the home page.

Hello Jordan,

We're aware of the gallery glitch. At the moment, the gallery is using placeholder images, and we're waiting for the final images from you. We'd prefer to replace those first and then address the glitch, as fixing it now may result in the same issue occurring again once the images are swapped.

We'll also remove the hover animations on mobile devices. We agree that hover effects don't provide the best experience on touch screens.

Regarding the pricing table, our recommendation is to keep the horizontal scroll on smaller screens. Since there are several columns, it's the most practical way to ensure all of the information remains readable on mobile devices. An alternative approach would be to keep the first column fixed while allowing the remaining columns to scroll horizontally, similar to how it's implemented here on mobile: <https://hartcore.live/plans/>. Let us know which approach you prefer or if you have something else in mind.

We'll also update the homepage buttons so they link directly to the Gallery, Pricing, and Services pages as requested.

We'll get started on these changes and get back to you with an update. In the meantime, we look forward to hearing your preference for the pricing table approach so we can implement the option that works best for you.

Thank you! 🙂

Hello Jordan,

Just a quick update for you.

We've updated the homepage buttons, and they now link directly to their respective pages (Gallery, Pricing, and Services).

Regarding the hover animations, this is a limitation of WordPress Elementor. If we remove the hover effects on mobile, they'll also be removed from the desktop version, as Elementor doesn't allow separate hover settings for desktop and mobile in this case.

Please let us know if you'd still like us to remove the hover effects entirely, or if you'd prefer to keep them as they are.

We're also looking forward to hearing your preference for the pricing table approach so we can implement the option that works best for you.

Thank you!

Sounds good. The animations are great; we can keep them. For now, the pricing approach is good. I will brainstorm it and update you if anything changes. Also, how many photos will I need to send you to get the gallery set up properly? I am pulling from my portfolio now.

Yes, we can definitely do that. A dedicated Quote page with a custom form is a great solution for now, and we can always integrate a scheduling tool like Calendly later if you decide to. I'll create a form with the fields you mentioned: Name, Company (optional), Phone Number, Email, and Job Description.
